import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import syntax
def try_parse(text):
    try:
        rules, atoms, symbols = syntax.parse(text)
        return 'accept(atoms=%d,symbols=%d)' % (atoms, symbols)
    except syntax.PolicyError as exc:
        return 'reject(%s)' % exc
print('nonlit 4 :', try_parse('contains(A) allow; startswith(B) allow; endswith(A) allow; contains(B,A) drop;'))
print('nonlit 5 :', try_parse('contains(A) allow; startswith(B) allow; endswith(A) allow; contains(B,A) drop; endswith(B,A) allow;'))
print('nonlit reuse:', try_parse('(contains(A) or contains(A)) allow; (startswith(B) and contains(A)) drop;'))
big32 = ''.join('match(A%d) allow;' % i for i in range(32768))
print('atoms total 32768:', try_parse(big32))
print('atoms total 32769:', try_parse(big32 + 'match(B32768) allow;'))
path65536 = ''.join('match(A%d,B%d) allow;' % (i, i) for i in range(32768))
print('symbols 65536:', try_parse(path65536))
print('symbols 65537:', try_parse(path65536 + 'match(A,B) allow;'))
def chain(depth):
    text='match(A)'
    for _ in range(depth-1):
        text='(match(B) or %s)' % text
    return text+' allow;'

print('depth 17:', try_parse(chain(17)))
